messages:
Alex (CEO): Quick Q3 pulse from me — high level notes and three open asks. TL;DR: momentum on Private GA, a region incident last week exposed a routing edge-case, and we need sharper cost controls for Hosted.
Maya (VP Product): Thanks Alex. Can you call out the top product metric we should all watch this week?
Alex (CEO): Primary metric: 95th p99 latency for text-gen on hosted (target <= 220ms). Secondary: Dedicated renewal conversion rate (goal 12% by EOW).
Raj (VP Eng): On latency — team has a kernel-level patch that drops p99 ~18% on 8k context. Scheduled for canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC. deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for rtm-runtime v2.4.1 -> 2 nodes in us-west-2.
Jordan (Head of SRE): Incident summary (last Thur): us-east routing flap caused ~18m elevated 5xx for Hosted. Root cause was a fallback policy loop between edge proxy and the smart-router when capacity signals collided. Mitigation applied: temporary circuit-breaker; long-term fix planned.
Emily (Dir, Ops): Ops note: retention policy change for debug logs — default 7d -> 30d for Dedicated customers with compliance add-on. CS/Legal looped; release notes ready.
Maya (VP Product): Private GA: EU pilot passed audit; we have one enterprise customer signed for early access next month. Need docs + runbook finalization. Who owns runbook?
Raj (VP Eng): I’ll assign eng owners. We need a short checklist for on-call handoff for private.
Lisa (Executive EA): Scheduling: Founders + VP sync on Mon 10:30 PT to approve runbook. Calendar invites sent.
Alex (CEO): Open asks: 1) Eng to confirm canary stability by Mon noon PT (Raj). 2) Product/Docs to finish GA runbook & customer checklist by Tue EOD (Maya). 3) Finance to propose incremental cost thresholds for Hosted by Wed (Emily).
Emily (Dir, Ops): Noted — Finance will propose threshold tiers and enforcement policy.
Jordan (Head of SRE): Postmortem draft for Thu incident will be in #postmortems by EOD today — asking for rapid review.
Maya (VP Product): One more: we should schedule a short customer comms draft for Private GA; Sasha in comms is ready to help.
Alex (CEO): Good. Also reminder: temporary quota increase is live for a handful of high-touch customers for the pilot, track cost delta.
Raj (VP Eng): LGTM. If canary is green I'll start gradual rollout and post progress in #eng-releases.
Maya (VP Product): Thanks — will ping Sasha and attach the draft to the runbook.
Lisa (Executive EA): Mon invite includes link to draft runbook and canary dashboard.
Alex (CEO): Appreciate the quick turn. Small org ask: escalate any unknown capacity fallbacks directly to Jordan + Raj — prefer page over slack.
Jordan (Head of SRE): Agreed, page us for anything evicting traffic policies.
Raj (VP Eng): Noted.
Maya (VP Product): Thanks everyone — will update this thread once runbook is complete.
deploy-bot: Canary completed: no errors observed in 12h window.
Alex (CEO): Great start — closing loop on this thread. Short check-in Mon after the canary. :rocket:
